# CreditBee Finance

> CreditBee Finance is an online digital lending platform in India providing instant personal loans from ₹6,000 to ₹10 Lakhs through RBI-registered NBFCs and banks, with interest from 5% p.a. and disbursal within 10 minutes across all India.

## Key Facts

- Website: https://creditbeefinance.github.io/
- Loan Amount: ₹6,000 to ₹10 Lakhs
- Interest Rate: 5% to 27.5% p.a.
- Tenure: 6 to 60 months
- Processing Fee: Up to 4.7% + GST or flat ₹1,250
- Disbursal: Within 10 minutes
- Eligibility: Indian citizen, 21+, ₹10,000 monthly income, salaried or self-employed
- Contact: +91 98765 43210 | support@creditbeefinance.in
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919876543210

## Services

- Instant Personal Loans
- Home, Business, Car, Education, Gold, Property & Wedding Loans
- Loan Settlement Assistance
